comments.author: Jingqi Tian
Jingqi Tian
comments.text: 这个bug与semi join的策略有关，仅当策略为MaterializeScan时，会触发这个bug。

comments.author: Jingqi Tian
comments.text: Please ignore the previous comment. This bug is related to the semi join strategy and is triggered only when the strategy is MaterializeScan.
